product_overview: Triplyy is an AI-powered route-sharing and carpooling platform for Egypt that helps drivers post trips and passengers discover overlapping rides. The product emphasizes route-based matching, org-email trust gating, safety/moderation, loyalty rewards, and admin operations.
core_goals: Enable secure authentication and trusted onboarding for drivers and passengers
Support driver ride creation with route calculation, fare estimation, and live trip management
Help passengers discover, preview, and book rides using geo search and AI ranking
Provide verification, group, and sponsored-group workflows gated by org-domain email ownership
Track bookings, ratings, loyalty, wallets, and financial/admin workflows
Capture fraud signals and operational data for moderation and future risk modeling

features.name: Health
features.description: Provide basic liveness and readiness checks for the API.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 indicating the service is alive -> GET /api/health -> Receive 200 from the API-prefixed health alias
GET /health with dependency failure -> Receive non-200 status or degraded health response -> Use result for operational alerting

features.name: Auth
features.description: Allow users to request and verify OTPs, sign in with password, refresh tokens, set passwords, and sign out using Supabase-backed authentication.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/request-otp with a valid email -> Receive 200 indicating OTP delivery was initiated -> POST /api/auth/verify-otp with valid email and OTP code -> Receive session tokens and authenticated access

POST /api/auth/sign-in-with-password with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> POST /api/auth/refresh with refresh token -> Receive new access token -> POST /api/auth/sign-out with bearer token -> Receive 200 and session revocation
POST /api/auth/request-otp with an invalid or unknown email -> Receive 4xx validation or auth error -> POST /api/auth/verify-otp with an incorrect OTP -> Receive 4xx invalid-code error
PUT /api/auth/password with missing or invalid bearer token -> Receive 401/403 authorization error -> Retry PUT /api/auth/password with valid token and payload -> Receive 200 and updated password

features.name: Profiles
features.description: Let authenticated users set up, view, and update their profile, upload a photo, and view other users' public profile and rating summaries.
user_flows: POST /api/profiles/setup with role and display_name after signup -> Receive 201 and created profile -> GET /api/profiles/me with bearer token -> Receive current profile details -> PUT /api/profiles/me with updated fields -> Receive 200 with saved profile changes
POST /api/profiles/me/photo with an image file -> Receive 200 and updated profile photo -> GET /api/profiles/me -> Receive profile containing new photo reference
GET /api/profiles/{user_id}/public with a valid token -> Receive 200 with another user's public profile -> GET /api/profiles/{user_id}/rating -> Receive 200 with rating summary
GET /api/profiles/me with missing bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> PUT /api/profiles/me with invalid data -> Receive 4xx validation error

features.name: Verification (org-email)
features.description: Allow users to submit verification documents and check verification status, while the current trust floor for product access remains org-email verification elsewhere in the system.

POST /api/verification/submit with missing file fields -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /api/verification/status -> Receive unchanged status
GET /api/verification/status with missing bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Org Access Verification

user_flows: POST /api/v1/org-access/request with a claimed org-domain email -> Receive 200 and OTP request accepted -> POST /api/v1/org-access/confirm with the correct OTP -> Receive 200 and profile updated with org_verified_at and org_verified_domain
POST /api/v1/org-access/request with an invalid or non-org email domain -> Receive 4xx error -> POST /api/v1/org-access/confirm with an incorrect OTP -> Receive 4xx invalid-code error
POST /api/v1/org-access/confirm with missing bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

POST /api/vehicles/register with invalid payload -> Receive 422 validation error -> POST /api/vehicles/me/update-request without auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/admin/vehicle-updates/{request_id}/reject for a nonexistent request -> Receive 4xx not-found or invalid-state error

scikit-learn / XGBoost (AI match-score service, separate microservice)

features.name: Rides
features.description: Core ride lifecycle for drivers — create (OSRM route + fare calc), list, edit, live location updates, cancel/start/complete, and passenger-facing preview/detail (with AI match score) and booking management.

endpoints.description:
Driver posts a new ride. Requires an active vehicle + org-verified profile. Calls OSRM for route geometry/distance/duration and computes fare. Reliably 503s in local dev (OSRM not configured, error body {"error":"route_intelligence_unavailable"}). Fires a background fraud_signal_service "ride_posted" event. IMPORTANT request body shape — origin/destination are NESTED objects, not flat strings: {
  "origin": {"coordinates": {"lat": <float>, "lng": <float>}, "address": "<str>"},
  "destination": {"coordinates": {"lat": <float>, "lng": <float>}, "address": "<str>"},
  "departure_datetime": "<ISO8601 str>",
  "total_seats": <int>,
  "vehicle_id": "<uuid>"
} A flat body like {"origin": "Cairo, Egypt", ...} or {"origin": {"address": "..."}} (missing "coordinates") fails Pydantic validation with 422.

features.name: Internal Webhooks & Route Intelligence
features.description: Internal-only endpoints — a driver-revocation webhook and route/compatibility feature computation for the AI matching pipeline, both secret-gated (not end-user-facing).

endpoints.description: Internal webhook fired when a driver's access/session is revoked. Hidden from the OpenAPI schema. Auth is via an X-Webhook-Secret header matched against settings.webhook_secret (NOT a Bearer JWT). Required JSON body (RevocationPayload): {"driver_id": str, "revocation_type": str}. Missing body/wrong auth scheme fails with 422 (body validated before the secret check).

Internal endpoint computing route-compatibility features consumed by the AI match-score service. NOTE the real path has NO "-features" suffix (it is exactly ".../compatibility"). Requires an X-Internal-Secret header matched against settings.internal_secret (NOT an end-user Bearer token). Required JSON body (CompatibilityFeaturesRequest): {"ride_id": UUID, "passenger_origin": {lat,lng}, "passenger_destination": {lat,lng}, "requested_departure_time": ISO8601 str} — NOT the driver_route/passenger_route+waypoints shape one might guess. 404 if ride_id doesn't exist or has no route_geometry; 503 if OSRM unavailable (same as Rides).

known_limitations.issue: Internal endpoints authenticate via a shared internal secret header, not the standard Supabase Bearer token used by all other endpoints.
known_limitations.impact: TestSprite's single Bearer-token auth config cannot exercise these two endpoints; expect 401/403 here and treat it as expected, not a bug.

known_limitations.issue: OSRM routing engine is not configured in local dev.
known_limitations.impact: POST /api/v1/rides reliably returns 503 locally regardless of code correctness; any test scenario depending on ride creation will fail for this reason alone.

known_limitations.issue: FCM push notifications are skipped locally (no service-account secret configured).
known_limitations.impact: Push-dependent flows (verification decisions, booking confirmations, etc.) will not deliver real push notifications in this environment, though the enqueue calls should still succeed.

known_limitations.issue: The provided Bearer token belongs to a single verified driver test account (with an active vehicle and org_verified_at set).
known_limitations.impact: Endpoints gated by get_current_passenger or get_current_admin will correctly 403 for this token; this is expected role-based access control behavior, not a bug. A passenger-role token exists separately but only one credential can be configured at a time.

known_limitations.issue: National ID / photo identity verification was removed entirely from the product for legal reasons.
known_limitations.impact: Do not expect or test for ID-document verification gates; org-email verification (org_access) is the only trust floor in the current codebase.
